description:
🍦 Ultra Low-Fat Vanilla Ice Cream 
Learn how to make a scoopable, creamy ultra low-fat vanilla ice cream using allulose and retrograded tapioca (RS3). This recipe cuts skim milk powder to save calories while keeping texture via whey, inulin an RS3 (optional ad not used in the video). Perfect for home and small-batch production — I show the rationale, the exact ingredient list, and the critical processing steps.

Ingredients: 
Skim milk 630g (set 30g aside for use after chilling phase)
Skim milk powder 100g
Whey protein concentrate 80% 30g
Allulose 150g
Maltodextrin 40g
Inulin 30g
Stabilizers 4g
Lecithin 2g
Vanilla extract 10g
Added water 34g

---------------
Timestamps:
00:00 — Intro, the science, goals, essential ingredients (LONG section)
05:30 — Building the recipe
10:03 — Post chill viscocity
10:35 — Churn
11:01 — Scooping and eating
11:44 — More science stuff and outro

-----------------
 
Keywords:

ultra low fat ice cream, low calorie ice cream, allulose ice cream, RS3 ice cream, retrograded tapioca, inulin ice cream, whey protein ice cream, Musso ice cream, ice cream formulation, food science, low fat dessert, homemade ice cream, protein ice cream, healthy ice cream recipe

⸻

👍 Like this video if you want more lab-style recipes and practical food-science explanations. Subscribe for Part 2 — we’ll show RS3 production (retrogradation) and the full production workflow to perfect texture and shelf stability.
